designationHistory.name: Benton Lake Bird Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Herbert Hoover established the Benton Lake Bird Refuge by Executive Order 5228; it is now Benton Lake National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Benton Lake National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 5228—Establishing Benton Lake Bird Refuge, Montana (Nov 21, 1929)

designationHistory.indexOriginal: the Refuge was established in 1929, the flooding of the wetland basin fluctuated with the amount of natural runoff received.
